name: eduverse-monorepo
description: EduVerse — Learn Beyond Boundaries (Educational SaaS Platform)

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['apps/web/.next', 'apps/api/dist'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })); console.log('Cleaned build artifacts');"
scripts.clean:next: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('apps/web/.next', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Cleaned Next.js cache');"
